question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is** "Jewelerry."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Jewellery."** • The incorrect option 3 has an extra** "r"** in it. • The correct spelling follows the British English convention. • The word refers to decorative items worn for personal adornment, such as necklaces, earrings, and bracelets. (अँगूठियाँ आदि आभूषण) • **Example**: *I love that piece of **jewellery**__.* • The correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Revolutionise", **is spelled correctly and means to fundamentally change or transform something. (किसी को पूरी तरह बदल देना, क्रांति ले आना (प्रायः उसमें सुधार के साथ)) • **Option 2, "Professional",** is spelled correctly and refers to someone who is skilled or trained in a particular job or activity. (उच्‍च स्‍तरीय प्रशिक्षण और/या शिक्षा की अपेक्षा वाले व्‍यवसाय या पेशे से संबंधित; व्‍यावसायिक, पेशेवराना) • **Option 4, "Conscientiousness",** is spelled correctly and refers to the quality of being diligent, careful, and thorough in one's work. (अपने काम में मेहनती, सावधान और संपूर्ण होने का गुण) 41:T499, The correct answer is **"more brave than intelligent."**
